# 同參經

**Date (file):** 2015-08-29 17:52:45.834658
**Base edition:** CK-KZ

## Authors / Editors
- DZJY  同參經

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Scripture of Joint Investigation*

planchette-revealed by **Lǚzǔ** ([呂洞賓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%91%82%E6%B4%9E%E8%B3%93)); preface by [文昌帝君](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%87%E6%98%8C%E5%B8%9D%E5%90%9B) (Wénchāng dìjūn); title-poem and editorial work by [柳守元](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9F%B3%E5%AE%88%E5%85%83) (Liǔ Shǒuyuán)

A Lǚ-zǔ-cult planchette compendium presented as a *Three-Teachings synthesis* (合三教以立言), composed of citations from the Six Classics, the Five Sages, the *zǐshū* of the philosophers, and Buddhist-Daoist scriptures, woven together to demonstrate the unity (同 *tóng*) of the three traditions when severally examined (參 *cān*). The title pun-references the *Cān tóng qì* of Wèi Bóyáng — Liǔ Shǒuyuán's title-poem makes the connection explicit: "Of old, Master Wèi Bóyáng wrote the *Cān tóng qì* anchored on the *Yì*-principle, specially clarifying the elixir-Way; now our Master Lǚ has gathered the Three Teachings in one source… therefore named the *Tóng cān jīng*. The current world has corrupted *Tóng cān* as *Cān tóng* — therefore I first head the title with this clarification."

**Abstract**

A Three-Teachings synthesis compendium in the Lǚzǔ planchette tradition, edited by Liǔ Shǒuyuán with a Wénchāngdìjūn preface. The title is a deliberate pun on the *Cān tóng qì* — re-routing the Sòng-Yuán *Cāntóng* tradition through a planchette-revealed Three-Teachings frame. Composition c. 1700–1750.

The work is an editorial product of the same DZJY-source milieu (Liǔ Shǒuyuán's circle, Húběi / Sìchuān, early-Qián-lóng) that produced the parallel works at [KR5i0005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0005), [KR5i0027](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0027), [KR5i0044](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0044) etc.
